dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, I'm writing a greeting card to your family. What should I write?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, aɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ ə ˈɡriːtɪŋ ˌkɑːrd tə jʊr ˈfæməli. ˈwʌt ʃʊd aɪ ˈraɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. And then "I wish you a happy New Year." Is that OK?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈðɛn "aɪ ˈwɪʃ juː ə ˈhæpi ˈnuː ˈjɪr." ɪz ˈðæt oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Perfect! Then write "Best wishes" and your name.
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt! ˈðɛn ˈraɪt "ˌbɛst ˈwɪʃɪz" ənd jʊr ˈneɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great, thanks. Oh, and you passed your Thai exam! Congratulations!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt, ˈθæŋks. ˈoʊ, ənd juː ˈpæst jʊr ˈtaɪ ɪɡˈzæm! kənˌɡrætʃəˈleɪʃənz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you! I studied every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! aɪ ˈstʌdid ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I wish you good luck with your next exam, too!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɪʃ juː ˈɡʊd ˈlʌk wɪð jʊr ˈnɛkst ɪɡˈzæm, ˈtuː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks, Nam! You're a good friend.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm! jʊr ə ˈɡʊd ˈfrɛnd.
